panels.title: Heating runtime

targets.queryText: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(MIN(COALESCE(ended, CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)), ($__to / 1000)) - MAX(started, ($__from / 1000))), 0) / 3600.0, 2) AS value FROM hvac_runs WHERE kind = 'HEAT' AND started < ($__to / 1000) AND COALESCE(ended, CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)) > ($__from / 1000)

panels.title: Temperature

targets.queryText: SELECT (time / CAST(MAX(30, $__interval_ms / 1000) AS INTEGER)) * CAST(MAX(30, $__interval_ms / 1000) AS INTEGER) AS time, ROUND(AVG(temp_f), 2) AS "Thermostat", ROUND(AVG(sensor_temp_f), 2) AS "Remote sensor", ROUND(AVG(heat_to_f), 2) AS "Heat-to", ROUND(AVG(cool_to_f), 2) AS "Cool-to", ROUND(AVG(target_f), 2) AS "Target" FROM thermostat_readings WHERE time >= ($__from / 1000) AND time <= ($__to / 1000) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (time / CAST(MAX(30, $__interval_ms / 1000) AS INTEGER)) * CAST(MAX(30, $__interval_ms / 1000) AS INTEGER) AS time, ROUND(AVG(temp_f), 2) AS "Thermostat", ROUND(AVG(sensor_temp_f), 2) AS "Remote sensor", ROUND(AVG(heat_to_f), 2) AS "Heat-to", ROUND(AVG(cool_to_f), 2) AS "Cool-to", ROUND(AVG(target_f), 2) AS "Target" FROM thermostat_readings WHERE time >= ($__from / 1000) AND time <= ($__to / 1000) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, running AS "HVAC" FROM thermostat_readings WHERE time >= ($__from / 1000) AND time <= ($__to / 1000) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Runtime per day

targets.queryText: SELECT day AS "Day", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'HEAT' THEN seconds ELSE 0 END) / 3600.0, 2) AS "Heat", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'COOL' THEN seconds ELSE 0 END) / 3600.0, 2) AS "Cool", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'FAN' THEN seconds ELSE 0 END) / 3600.0, 2) AS "Fan" FROM hvac_runs WHERE ended IS NOT NULL AND started >= ($__from / 1000) AND started <= ($__to / 1000) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT day AS "Day", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'HEAT' THEN seconds ELSE 0 END) / 3600.0, 2) AS "Heat", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'COOL' THEN seconds ELSE 0 END) / 3600.0, 2) AS "Cool", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'FAN' THEN seconds ELSE 0 END) / 3600.0, 2) AS "Fan" FROM hvac_runs WHERE ended IS NOT NULL AND started >= ($__from / 1000) AND started <= ($__to / 1000) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Hours each system ran per day (local time). Set the time range to a billing period to compare with your bill.

panels.title: Runtime per month (all time)

targets.queryText: SELECT substr(day, 1, 7) AS "Month", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'HEAT' THEN seconds ELSE 0 END) / 3600.0, 2) AS "Heat", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'COOL' THEN seconds ELSE 0 END) / 3600.0, 2) AS "Cool", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'FAN' THEN seconds ELSE 0 END) / 3600.0, 2) AS "Fan" FROM hvac_runs WHERE ended IS NOT NULL  GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
